_doc: PROJECT-scoped Claude Code settings — the SoT for the settings.json committed into every repo under cloud. It carries the machine-independent half of settings.base.json + settings.desktop.json (its neighbours here, the SoT for ~/.claude/settings.json). cloud-infra's 9_others/src/deploy-dotfiles.sh copies this file to 0_apps/src/claude/settings.json on every dotfiles build, which then deploys to <repo>/.claude/settings.json. Edit HERE; the copies are generated. It used to be hand-kept in cloud-infra with an instruction to 're-copy', and three repos had drifted the first time anything looked.
_why_committed: ~/.claude/settings.json only exists where unix's home-manager has run. A fresh clone — CI, a container, Claude Code on the web, a second machine, someone else's checkout — has no user config, so without this the repo gets Claude's stock defaults: no thinking, no tool search, no agents. Project settings merge OVER user settings, so on a home-manager machine these keys are already what ~/.claude sets and the merge is a no-op.
_deliberately_absent: Everything from settings.base.json that carries a @HOME@ path: statusLine.command, and env GIT_BASE / NODE_PATH / AUTHELIA_OIDC_CREDENTIALS_DIR / AUTHELIA_OIDC_TOKENS_DIR. unix substitutes @HOME@ with config.home.homeDirectory at nix eval time, per machine. A committed file has no such step, so those paths would harden to one person's home directory and be wrong in every clone — the same failure .mcp.json had as a symlink to /home/diego/.mcp.json. They stay in ~/.claude, where the substitution happens.
_also_absent: enabledPlugins. Those name @cloud-marketplace and @claude-plugins-official entries that are installed per-machine; enabling a plugin that is not installed is noise in every clone that lacks it. Plugin choice stays user-level.

env._ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH_comment: auto, mirrored from settings.base.json. 'true' force-defers EVERY MCP tool behind Tool Search unconditionally; 'auto' defers only past 10% of context (~20k tokens) so the lean detached servers (cgc-pub etc.) stay eager while the fat, mostly-disabled cloud-services-mcp aggregator is what trips deferral when enabled. Project settings merge OVER user, so this MUST match base.json or it silently re-forces 'true' inside every repo.
env._AUTHELIA_comment: The NON-SECRET half of what mcp-auth-headers.sh needs, placed here because this is the only delivery path that is early enough. A container runs no home-manager, so settings.base.json never lands; and anything a session does after it starts — cloning the vault, exporting a variable, running a hook — arrives after the MCP client has already bound and taken its 403. That ordering is the whole reason c3-infra-mcp has never autoloaded off-mesh. This file is read at session start and its env DOES reach the process: ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH above was verified live in a container shell, sourced from here.
env._AUTHELIA_secret_comment: The SECRET is absent and must stay absent — this file is committed into every repo, several of them public. It is the one value that has to come from the remote environment's OWN variable config, which is the only carrier that exists before the process starts. Set ONE of: AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN (a ready-made bearer; works today) or AUTHELIA_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET (mints a short-lived token per session; preferred, but blocked until the Authelia clients stop rejecting as invalid_client). One variable, set once — everything else is declared here and deployed by the dotfiles build.

_disabledMcpjsonServers_comment: Default-OFF the two fat aggregators (mirror of settings.base.json) so the auto 10% cap is spent on the lean detached servers and cgc-pub stays eager. cloud-services-mcp (master index, ~139 tools) + cloud-infra-mcp (devops/obs/sec, ~138) are ~40k eager and force everything to defer. /mcp re-enables either on demand.

permissions._doc: Left empty on purpose. Pre-approving commands is a per-person trust decision, not a repo-wide one — the /fewer-permission-prompts skill generates an allowlist from your own transcripts. defaultMode is user-level too: settings.base.json sets "auto", and forcing it from a committed file would override that choice for anyone who clones this repo.
